units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
after a moment's reflection.
You had better give me the remittance. He will want it for his hotel bill. I'll see whether I can induce him to accept it. Not now, of course, but presently.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: eagerly.
Yes, yes, yes: that's just the thing
units.name: MALONE

units.text: he hands her the thousand dollar bill, and adds cunningly.
Y'understand that this is only a bachelor allowance.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: Coolly.
Oh, quite.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: She takes it.
Thank you. By the way, Mr Malone, those two houses you mentioned--the abbeys.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: Yes?
units.name: MALONE

units.text: Don't take one of them until I've seen it. One never knows what may be wrong with these places.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: I won't. I'll do nothing without consulting you, never fear.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: politely, but without a ray of gratitude.
Thanks: that will be much the best way.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: She goes calmly back to the villa, escorted obsequiously by Malone to the upper end of the garden.
drawing Ramsden's attention to Malone's cringing attitude as he takes leave of Violet.

And that poor devil is a billionaire! one of the master spirits of the age! Led on a string like a pug dog by the first girl who takes the trouble to despise him. I wonder will it ever come to that with me.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: He comes down to the lawn.
following him.
The sooner the better for you.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: clapping his hands as he returns through the garden.
That'll be a grand woman for Hector. I wouldn't exchange her for ten duchesses.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: He descends to the lawn and comes between Tanner and Ramsden.
very civil to the billionaire.
It's an unexpected pleasure to find you in this corner of the world, Mr Malone. Have you come to buy up the Alhambra?
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: Well, I don't say I mightn't. I think I could do better with it than the Spanish government. But that's not what I came about. To tell you the truth, about a month ago I overheard a deal between two men over a bundle of shares. They differed about the price: they were young and greedy, and didn't know that if the shares were worth what was bid for them they must be worth what was asked, the margin being too small to be of any account, you see. To amuse meself, I cut in and bought the shares. Well, to this day I haven't found out what the business is. The office is in this town; and the name is Mendoza, Limited. Now whether Mendoza's a mine, or a steamboat line, or a bank, or a patent article--
units.name: MALONE

units.text: He's a man. I know him: his principles are thoroughly commercial. Let us take you round the town in our motor, Mr Malone, and call on him on the way.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: If you'll be so kind, yes. And may I ask who--
units.name: MALONE

units.text: Mr Roebuck Ramsden, a very old friend of your daughter-in-law.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Happy to meet you, Mr Ramsden.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: Thank you. Mr Tanner is also one of our circle.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: Glad to know you also, Mr Tanner.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: Thanks.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Malone and Ramsden go out very amicably through the little gate.
Tanner calls to Octavius, who is wandering in the garden with Ann.
Tavy!
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Tavy comes to the steps, Tanner whispers loudly to him.
Violet has married a financier of brigands.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Tanner hurries away to overtake Malone and Ramsden.
Ann strolls to the steps with an idle impulse to torment Octavius.
Won't you go with them, Tavy?
units.name: ANN

units.text: tears suddenly flushing his eyes.
You cut me to the heart, Ann, by wanting me to go
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: he comes down on the lawn to hide his face from her.
She follows him caressingly.
Poor Ricky Ticky Tavy! Poor heart!
units.name: ANN

units.text: It belongs to you, Ann. Forgive me: I must speak of it. I love you. You know I love you.
units.name: OCTAVIUS
